name: Jai Santhoshi Sathish Kumar
intro:
I'm Jai Santhoshi, a ==management consultant== who paints on Sundays, co-hosts ==Ground Up==, and is moving soon for ==business school==.

I like big questions, small details, long walks and good chai. This site is where I keep the things I make, read, watch and think about.
tagline: Management consultant, Sunday painter, podcast co-host.
